title: Add App Submission: FreeChat CLI to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [App Submission: FreeChat CLI](https://github.com/xiaotian1171/freechat-cli) to chat
- A zero-config command-line chat tool powered by the Pollinations free API. No API key required. Features include multi-model switching, streaming responses, conversation history, and save/load. Uses t

Fixes #11438

gist.headline: Chat from the shell
gist.blurb: FreeChat CLI has joined the garden: a zero-config terminal chat tool running on the Pollinations free API. Pick a model, keep your history, stream the answer, and avoid hunting for an API key.
gist.summary: Added FreeChat CLI to the community app directory, a zero-config Pollinations-powered command-line chat client with multi-model switching, streaming responses, conversation history, and save/load support without an API key.
gist.impact: Developers can now discover a ready-to-use terminal chat client for trying Pollinations models, carrying conversations forward, and saving sessions from the shell.
gist.visual_concept: Depict FreeChat CLI as a cozy retro terminal in a small garden shed, with chat messages and model tabs on its CRT screen. Polli, wearing tiny developer headphones, hovers beside the keyboard tending a code-plant that grows from the command prompt, showing that terminal chat can be friendly, persistent, and ready without setup.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden-shed hackerspace with a retro CRT terminal glowing prominently lime green (#ecf874), showing simple pixel text "freechat" and flowing chat lines with small model tabs; code-plants sprout from pots around the keyboard. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny developer headphones and warmly tends the terminal's code-plant. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle scanlines, emotionally warm.
